code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia (low hemoglobin, MCHC), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated monocytes and basophils, increased RDW, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine, urea). There is also mild hypoglycemia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, and INR, suggesting inflammation and possible coagulopathy. These findings may indicate acute systemic illness (e.g., infection, inflammation, or hypoxic injury) and warrant urgent clinical evaluation and further diagnostic workup.
